name: @pps/web
//dependencies: sharp and onnxruntime-node are listed here even though only @pps/features imports them. They are in serverExternalPackages, which means Next requires them from node_modules RELATIVE TO THIS APP at runtime - and under pnpm's isolated layout a transitive dependency is not there. REMOVING THEM BREAKS THE ROUTE AT FIRST INVOCATION, NOT AT BUILD TIME: the build goes green and /api/health-onnx returns "Could not load the sharp module". Verify on a preview deployment, never from a local build - see CLAUDE.md > Deployment gotchas.
